summary: Add deterministic exhaustive repository-object inventory and full-range semantic-processing coverage controls.
reason: This changes the evidence required for an exhaustive repository-wide coverage claim. The new manifest pins a Git commit and inventories every tracked tree entry; the coverage checker requires matching object identity, assigned semantic method, COMPLETE semantic status, and complete line/byte/object ranges. Search, sampling, snippets, exclusions, and inaccessible entries cannot satisfy an exhaustive claim. Bounded same-agent review supported all five review stages and the declared evaluations. A live protected pull-request run passed changed-file coverage and all 37 regression tests before stopping at the intentionally unresolved queue gate. The deterministic coverage controls are explicitly limited to proving inventory identity and declared processing ranges; they do not claim to prove model comprehension or semantic correctness.
